title: Pogumidam Vegu Thooramillai
desc: A mortuary van driver tries to transport the body of an old man to a village but runs into several obstacles on the way.

title: Kaithi
desc: An ex-convict's fresh start to life is threatened by vengeful enemies, compelling him to confront the dangers for a chance at freedom.

title: Aruvam
desc: A woman with anosmia experiences paranormal events and soon finds herself involved in a series of mysterious murders linked to food adulteration.

title: Shadow
desc: Raghuram, a journalist, exposes the criminal activities of an infamous gangster, who later murders him as revenge. Years later, Rajaram, Raghuram's son, decides to track down the killer.

title: Avan Ivan
desc: A benevolent landlord embraces two half-brothers as his chosen family, nurturing their dreams, but their lives take a perilous turn when they cross paths with a notorious cattle smuggler.

title: Mirai
desc: When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.

title: Cuckoo
desc: Tamil and Kodi, a visually impaired couple, undergo many hardships to unite when they learn that Kodi's brother has decided to marry her off to someone else in return for a favour.

title: Kalyana Vaibhogam
desc: Santhi, an ardent admirer of Sakthi, a writer, falls in love with him and sends him anonymous letters. But problems arise when he mistakes his secret lady admirer for someone else.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Thoongaavanam
desc: When a drug lord ransoms police officer Diwakar's son for a bag of cocaine, he has no choice but to steal it from police headquarters. However, this raises the suspicions of his colleague Mallika.

title: Sangili Bungili Kadhava Thorae
desc: Vasu, a young broker, purchases a bungalow for his family in the outskirts of town. However, they soon start to feel the presence of supernatural forces in the building.

title: Sulthan
desc: Sultan, a motherless child, is raised by a group of criminals working for his father. However, when his father dies, he decides to reform the group into better people.

title: Thug Life
desc: Adopted by a gang leader, Amaran faces suspicion after an assassination attempt.

title: Viruman
desc: Viruman is a young man who watches his mother immolate herself. As a result, he distances himself from his father and vows to avenge her death.

title: Max
desc: Max, a military dog, returns to the United States after a traumatic experience in Afghanistan. However, his handler's family adopt him and strive to help him recover.
